career_ladder.note: Officers recruited through the Uttarakhand Combined State Civil / Upper Subordinate Services Examination (Uttarakhand PCS) into administrative cadre posts like Deputy Collector enter the Uttarakhand Civil Service (Executive Branch). Career progression follows state administrative pay levels up to induction into the Indian Administrative Service (IAS — Uttarakhand Cadre) under the IAS (Appointment by Promotion) Regulations.

exam_scheme.note: The Uttarakhand Combined State Civil / Upper Subordinate Services Examination (UKPSC PCS) is conducted in three successive stages: Preliminary Examination (Objective screening test), Main Examination (Written descriptive examination of 8 compulsory papers totaling 1,500 marks), and Personality Test / Interview (150 marks). Final selection merit is determined out of 1,650 marks.

stages.source_label: UKPSC PCS Advt. No. A-1/E-1/2026-27 Appendix-2 Examination Scheme

papers.paper_name: Paper I: General Studies (Indian History, Polity, Economy, Geography, Environment, and Uttarakhand GK)
papers.negative_marking: 0.25 mark (1/4th penalty for each wrong answer)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Merit determining; marks determine the shortlist for Main examination. Minimum 1/3 (50 questions) mandatorily based on Uttarakhand state.

papers.paper_name: Paper II: General Aptitude Test (Comprehension, Interpersonal Skills, Logical Reasoning, Decision Making, Basic Numeracy)
papers.negative_marking: 0.375 mark (1/4th penalty for each wrong answer, 1.5 marks per question)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 33% marks (49.5 out of 150) required to qualify; marks are not counted for Mains shortlisting merit.

stages.source_label: UKPSC PCS Advt. No. A-1/E-1/2026-27 Appendix-2 Examination Scheme

papers.qualifying_threshold: Merit paper; minimum 35% marks required to qualify
Merit paper; evaluated on structure, coherence, and depth of analysis

papers.paper_name: Paper 3: General Studies - I (Indian Heritage and Culture, World History, Geography and Society)
Paper 4: General Studies - II (Governance, Constitution, Polity, Social Justice and International Relations)
Paper 5: General Studies - III (Technology, Economic Development, Biodiversity, Environment, Security and Disaster Management)
Paper 6: General Studies - IV (Ethics, Integrity and Aptitude)
Paper 7: General Studies - V (Knowledge of Uttarakhand State — History, Geography, Economy, Governance)
Paper 8: General Studies - VI (Knowledge of Uttarakhand State — Society, Culture, Flora, Fauna, Disaster Profile)

stages.source_label: UKPSC PCS Advt. No. A-1/E-1/2026-27 Appendix-2 Examination Scheme

papers.qualifying_threshold: Comprehensive personality assessment; marks added to Mains written total (1,500 + 150 = 1,650 marks) for final ranking

financial_package.note: Officers recruited to administrative posts (Deputy Collector, DSP, Finance Officer, BDO, ARTO) under Uttarakhand Combined State Civil / Upper Subordinate Services are placed at Level-10 (Pay Scale ₹56,100 - ₹1,77,500) under the Uttarakhand State 7th Pay Commission pay rules.
financial_package.pay_source_label: UKPSC Advt. No. A-1/E-1/2026-27 (Post Code 1 to 14, Level-10)
financial_package.estimate_note: Gross salary computed from Level-10 Entry Basic Pay (₹56,100), Dearness Allowance at 58% (₹32,538), House Rent Allowance (9% in rural/smaller district stations to 18% in Dehradun / Tier-Y urban areas, or government residential accommodation), Hill Compensatory Allowance (for designated high-altitude mountain postings), and Medical Allowance (₹1,000/month flat). In-hand estimate accounts for statutory National Pension System (NPS) deduction of 10% on Basic + DA (₹8,864) and state group insurance.
official_perks: Government designated residential accommodation or House Rent Allowance (HRA) up to 18%
Official government transport / vehicle with driver entitlement for administrative field postings
Hill Compensatory Allowance (HCA) admissible for designated mountain district postings
Comprehensive medical treatment reimbursement under Uttarakhand State Health Schemes
Official mobile, broadband, and communication expense reimbursement
Leave travel concession (LTC) as per Uttarakhand Civil Services Rules
